game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 10: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Procedural classification.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
